recognize_zh: 同一視野並列不同強度：上方中性球有密集藍色顆粒（約 3 分），下方細胞整個被深藍色沉澱蓋住看不到核（4 分），右側與左下的淡紅色細胞則沒有顆粒（0 分）。
features: Upper neutrophil with dense blue granules, nucleus still faintly visible (about 3+)
Lower cell with intense confluent dark blue precipitate obscuring the nucleus (4+)
Adjacent pale cells with red nuclei and no blue granules (score 0)
describe_en: High-power view of a leukocyte alkaline phosphatase-stained peripheral blood smear demonstrates the grading spectrum within a single field. One neutrophil contains dense blue granules with a faintly visible nucleus (approximately 3+), another shows intense confluent dark blue reaction product completely obscuring the nucleus (4+), and nearby cells with red-counterstained nuclei lack any granules (0). The LAP score is the sum of grades for 100 consecutive neutrophils.

ddx.vs: These show sparse to moderate granules with clearly visible nuclear lobes, unlike the heavily stained cells here.
Lymphocytes and monocytes are excluded from scoring and are recognized by round or folded nonsegmented nuclei.
